title: Upper bound for layer vertex indices
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit whose gates use only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND operations. For every layer $m<\mathrm{depth}(F)+1$ and every node $u$ in layer $m$, the index assigned to $u$ is strictly less than $n$ plus the cumulative number of nodes in the successor layers preceding layer $m$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit over $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with $n$ inputs and output type $\mathrm{Unit}$
Every gate operation of $F$ is identity, NOT, or unbounded fan-in AND
